name: SCP: Secret Laboratory
description: Free multiplayer horror in the SCP universe. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous) and managed through the bundled LocalAdmin console.
notes: --acceptEULA accepts the SCP:SL EULA non-interactively on first boot. Configs are created per port under ~/.config/SCP Secret Laboratory/config/<port>/ (config_gameplay.txt, config_remoteadmin.txt) — on Windows under %AppData%. Public listing on the server browser requires a verification key from Northwood (email server hosting team). Console commands (stop, roundrestart, players) are forwarded through LocalAdmin. Windows hosts: set the start command override to LocalAdmin.exe {{SERVER_PORT}} --acceptEULA.
